text: 创业板指跌超1%，沪指跌0.08%，深成指跌0.58%，算力硬件、半导体芯片、机器人等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近2200只。
text_en: ChiNext fell over 1%, Shanghai index down 0.08%, Shenzhen component down 0.58%, with computing hardware, semiconductor chips, and robotics among the top decliners; nearly 2,200 stocks fell across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets.
